name: Mento Australian Dollar
oneLiner: AUDm is Mento's crypto-backed Australian dollar on Celo, minted by depositing USDm as Liquity-v2-style CDP collateral against the Mento reserve mix.
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard)
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing AUDm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the AUDm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg

oracleRisk.summary: AUDm's live Celo USDm/AUDm Broker exchange uses one SortedOracles reporter with a 360-second report-expiry window and minimumReports set to one; BreakerBox gates the swap but no second feed or failover path is configured.

branchApplicability.rationale: At Celo block 72127154, AUDm broker() returned the Mento v2 Broker and BiPoolManager exposed one USDm/AUDm exchange using rate feed 0x646bD504C3864Ea5b8A6B6D25743721f61864A07, minimumReports 1, and a 360-second reset/expiry window. SortedOracles had one reporter for that feed. The current Mento reserve API lists active CDP troves only for GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm, not AUDm, so AUDm has no live borrower-specific oracle/liquidation branch to enumerate.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Explicit possible: the tracked Celo proxy has no active holder blacklist, freeze, pause, or transfer hook in its verified implementation, but its owner can replace that holder-facing logic through the verified two-day Mento Timelock path. This direct possibility does not rely on, or suppress, separately evidenced upstream reserve exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Celo block 72186904, the sole tracked AUDm proxy 0x7175504c455076f15c04a2f90a8e352281f492f9 returned StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563B0604BE100F04B7Ae485BcafE3c9D8850E; proxy _getOwner() and delegated owner() both returned Mento Timelock 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147, whose getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. The verified proxy source restricts _setImplementation and _setAndInitializeImplementation to that owner, and MGP-16 documents use of the same method to switch StableToken logic. The active implementation's verified ABI/source has ordinary transfer and transferFrom, permissioned minting, self-burn for broker/exchange callers, and Celo-VM-only gas accounting, but no issuer/governance callable blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, or transfer-hook restriction; zero-value transfer and transferFrom simulations both returned true at the pinned block. Archived Forno calls at Celo block 69287341 returned the same implementation and owner, and a zero-value transfer simulation returned true. Mento's published legal source is a privacy notice, not direct token-control authority. Its live reserve API lists USDT, EURC, and USDC-family positions, while the archived dashboard confirms historical transparency availability; that upstream exposure remains distinct from this snapshot-specific direct result.

mintAuthority.summary: AUDm is minted via the Mento Broker (0x777A...) which is the sole authorized minter (broker() getter confirmed). The Broker's proxy admin and the AUDm token owner and proxy admin all resolve to the Mento Timelock (0x890DB...) with a 2-day delay.

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for AUDm
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, broker() on AUDm (0x7175504c455076f15c04a2f90a8e352281f492f9) returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy). The Broker's EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (Mento Timelock).

controls.label: Mento Timelock — AUDm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, owner() on AUDm returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the same address. getMinDelay() on the Timelock returned 0x2a300 = 172800 seconds (48 hours).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69287341: owner() = Timelock 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (confirmed); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = same Timelock; getMinDelay() = 172800s (48h); broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy, confirmed as sole authorized minter); Broker EIP-1967 proxy admin = same Timelock. Celo Registry confirms Broker = 0x777A... (keccak256('Broker') lookup). All mint-capable surfaces resolved. Economically, Broker issuance is the collateral-exchange path; changing that path or authorizing different mint logic requires the independently enforced 48-hour Mento Timelock, so the encoding-derived unbounded cap is superseded by raiseable semantics.
